_comment: Run from the repository root: these tests read the Go-minted fixture in packages/types by relative filesystem path, which a package-local sandbox cannot resolve. index.ts, driver.ts, and smoke.ts are excluded as executable entry points: each runs on import, each is exercised by the smoke gate rather than by unit tests, and mutating a top-level side effect measures nothing about assertion quality. The logic they carry lives in runner.ts and agent.ts, which are mutated.
